note: Who plays whom and where the scenes are, for the story lines written in docs/narrative/src (QST-010 to QST-015, ADR-0056). Tools/citysim/story.py reads this with the writing and writes World/rules/quests_story.json; change the writing or this file, never that one. 'cast': the writing's name for a person -> the resident who plays them. 'places': '<quest>.<stage>' -> the goal of a stage that is not a talk (a lot to go to, or a point with a radius; 'from' and 'to' are minutes of the day). 'covered': '<quest>.<stage>.<node>' -> why a node whose replies all have conditions always has one open, where the checker cannot work that out by itself (the play-through test proves it). 'lines': the files of the writing, in order. The Stone Oven is b_7_7_l2 on Baker Street. Not yet: Oda, Suvi and Len live in ordinary houses, because the mill house and Brook Farm's kitchen are not built (Game/README.md).
